en: So this is the villa in Medoekia
note: Christopher (speaker byte 12 = player). Script: 718+710+70C on one line, then wait.
Gives '....' (ellipsis + period), same as the OPN '...' + '.' precedent.

en: I'd heard it was an old building, but
I never imagined it would be this run-down.
This is the villa our Eisen clan uses
note: Rusalie (speaker byte 11) from here to @16C, except @3EC/@3C4 and Sistina's @360-@2C4.

en: when bringing humans to the castle.
You can use this place as your base.
During the day, no one can easily tell we're
Vampir just by looking at us.
That's why, in the daytime, we can act
just like humans.
Talk to all kinds of people, and learn
what sort of lives the villagers lead.
From how people live and work, you can tell
if they're strong or well respected.
Befriending villagers also changes
the effect of drinking blood, so vital to us.
When we drink blood at night, the effect
depends on how close our victim is to us.
note: No newline between @4A8 and @480 in the script: both print on this line and wrap; measured as 3 lines in total.

en: The closer they are, the greater the effect.
note: Leading space: printed right after @4A8 on the same line (no newline opcode).
Script prints the partner name (opcode 19 = Duran) before this row: '{PARTNER_NAME}...'. Trailing 、 dropped because the box is cleared before the next sentence.

en: The Vampir you must defeat has been sealed
in a tower for a long time, so at first
he shouldn't be able to act freely by day.
note: 'he' = Duran (named in @474 message; male per glossary).

en: , huh.
I wonder what kind of Vampir he is...
...Lastly, let me introduce you to
your new partner.
Come, Sistina.
How do you do, Master
Lord Ragash has ordered me to serve you.
My name is Sistina.
I shall mainly be gathering information
for you at night.
I look forward to serving you.
Sistina will always report to you on the
familiars you summon at night and those
you've made your servants.
Unlike the familiars you summon for a time,
she's a fine one, raised with us in Eisen,
so I'm sure she'll be a great help to you.
I'll be staying here at this villa, too,
for a while.
When it comes to what you should do next,
I think I can give you all kinds of advice.
I summoned a patent agent named Jonathan,
and at last succeeded in breaking the seal.
To hear the fellow tell it, in Europe's west,
London, in the British Empire, now stands
at the very summit of the world's prosperity.
I went to the trouble of buying an estate,
so I shall fill this British Empire of theirs
with terror and chaos...
But first, on the human rabble hereabouts,
I think I shall slake my thirst for blood.
So that I may grasp great power once more...
